starships.name: USS Enterprise (NCC-1701-A)
starships.description: The refitted Constitution-class starship commanded by Captain James T. Kirk. The third ship to bear the name Enterprise, it served as a flagship for exploration and diplomacy in the post-TOS era.

starships.name: USS Enterprise-D (NCC-1701-D)
starships.description: The Galaxy-class starship commanded by Captain Jean-Luc Picard. The first starship designed primarily for exploration and diplomacy rather than war. Features a massive crew complement and advanced scientific facilities.

starships.name: USS Enterprise-E (NCC-1701-E)
starships.description: The Sovereign-class starship commanded by Captain Jean-Luc Picard. Combines the scientific capabilities of the Enterprise-D with enhanced weapons and speed for combat situations.

starships.name: USS Voyager (NCC-74656)
starships.description: The Intrepid-class starship commanded by Captain Kathryn Janeway. Stranded in the Delta Quadrant, 70,000 light-years from home. The most advanced Starfleet ship of its time, with twin warp cores and advanced weaponry.

starships.name: USS Defiant (NCC-1764)
starships.description: The Defiant-class warship commanded by Captain Benjamin Sisko. Designed specifically for combat, the Defiant is heavily armed and armored for a ship of its size. Serves as the primary defense of Deep Space 9.

starships.name: IKS D7 Battlecruiser
starships.description: The D7-class battlecruiser is the backbone of the Klingon Defense Force. Heavily armed and armored, it is designed for combat and intimidation. The D7 is a symbol of Klingon military might.

starships.name: Klingon Bird-of-Prey
starships.description: The Bird-of-Prey is a small, fast Klingon warship used for reconnaissance, raiding, and boarding actions. Equipped with a cloaking device, it is a feared opponent in hit-and-run tactics.

starships.name: Romulan Warbird (D'deridex-class)
starships.description: The D'deridex-class Warbird is the flagship of the Romulan Star Fleet. Its distinctive wing-like pylons house powerful plasma torpedoes and phaser arrays. Equipped with an advanced cloaking device that allows warp while cloaked.

starships.name: Borg Cube
starships.description: The Borg Cube is a kilometer-long warship that serves as a mobile base for the Borg Collective. It houses millions of drones and possesses adaptive shielding that makes it nearly invulnerable. A single Cube can destroy an entire star system.

starships.name: Jem'Hadar Warship
starships.description: The Jem'Hadar warship is the primary combat vessel of the Dominion. Designed by the Cardassians for the Jem'Hadar, it is fast, heavily armed, and equipped with a cloaking device. Powered by a warp core that runs on Ketracel-white.

starships.name: Cardassian Galaxy-class Warship
starships.description: The Galaxy-class warship (not to be confused with the Starfleet Galaxy-class) is a versatile Cardassian warship used for patrol, occupation, and combat. It is the workhorse of the Cardassian military.

starships.name: Narada (Romulan Mining Ship)
starships.description: The Narada is a Romulan mining ship commanded by Nero. Displaced through a wormhole from the future, it possesses technology far beyond 23rd-century Starfleet capabilities, including tetryon weapons that can disable shields.

ground_units.name: Starfleet Security Team
ground_units.description: Standard Starfleet security personnel trained in combat, shipboard security, and planetary protection. Equipped with phasers and standard-issue uniforms.

ground_units.name: Klingon Warrior
ground_units.description: A trained Klingon warrior, skilled in the use of the bat'leth and hand laser. Klingon warriors fight for honor and glory, and are feared throughout the galaxy.

ground_units.name: Jem'Hadar Warrior
ground_units.description: A Jem'Hadar warrior, genetically engineered for combat. Under the influence of Ketracel-white, they are fearless, incredibly strong, and completely loyal to the Dominion.

ground_units.name: Borg Drone
ground_units.description: A Borg drone, assimilated into the Collective. Each drone is a specialized component of the whole, equipped with cybernetic implants and nanoprobes for assimilation.

ground_units.name: Cardassian Soldier
ground_units.description: A Cardassian military soldier, trained in occupation warfare and combat. Equipped with disruptors and standard Cardassian armor.

ground_units.name: Bajoran Resistance Fighter
ground_units.description: A Bajoran resistance fighter who fought against Cardassian occupation. Skilled in guerrilla tactics and sabotage.

characters.name: James T. Kirk
characters.description: Captain of the USS Enterprise. Bold, charismatic, and instinctive, Kirk is one of Starfleet's most celebrated commanders. Known for his daring maneuvers and ability to inspire his crew.

characters.name: Spock
characters.description: Vulcan-Human Science Officer and First Officer of the USS Enterprise. Master of logic, the Vulcan mind meld, and scientific analysis. Spock's unique heritage allows him to bridge the gap between logic and emotion.

characters.name: Jean-Luc Picard
characters.description: Captain of the USS Enterprise-D/E. A scholar, diplomat, and strategist, Picard represents the ideal Starfleet officer. His command style emphasizes diplomacy, reason, and moral integrity.

characters.name: Benjamin Sisko
characters.description: Captain of the USS Defiant and Station Commander of Deep Space 9. A military man and the Emissary of the Bajoran Prophets, Sisko balances his duties as a Starfleet officer with his role as a religious figure.

characters.name: Kathryn Janeway
characters.description: Captain of the USS Voyager. A brilliant scientist and determined leader, Janeway commands Voyager through the Delta Quadrant, 70,000 light-years from home. Her scientific curiosity and moral compass guide her decisions.

characters.name: Worf
characters.description: Klingon Security Chief serving on the USS Enterprise-D and later Deep Space 9. The first Klingon to serve on a Starfleet bridge, Worf is a skilled warrior and bat'leth master who struggles with his dual loyalty to Klingon honor and Starfleet duty.

characters.name: Data
characters.description: An android (synthetic being) serving as Second Officer of the USS Enterprise-D. Created by Dr. Noonien Soong, Data seeks to understand and become human. His superhuman abilities include immense strength, speed, and processing power.

characters.name: Seven of Nine
characters.description: A former Borg drone liberated by Voyager. Seven retains her Borg augmentations and knowledge while struggling to reclaim her humanity. Her tactical skills and Borg knowledge make her invaluable to Voyager.

characters.name: Gul Dukat
characters.description: Cardassian Gul and former Governor of Bajor. A charismatic and ruthless leader, Dukat allies with the Dominion to regain power. In the afterlife, he is empowered by the Pah-wraiths and commands the Negh'Var.

characters.name: Kira Nerys
characters.description: Former Bajoran resistance fighter and Operations Officer of Deep Space 9. A devout Bajoran and skilled warrior, Kira is the first non-Federation officer to command a Starfleet vessel.

characters.name: Elim Garak
characters.description: A Cardassian tailor on Deep Space 9 with a secret past as an agent of the Obsidian Order. Brilliant, manipulative, and enigmatic, Garak's true loyalties are always in question.

characters.name: Leonard 'Bones' McCoy
characters.description: Chief Medical Officer of the USS Enterprise. A human doctor in a starfleet full of scientists, McCoy provides the moral compass and emotional grounding for the Enterprise crew. His medical expertise is unmatched.
